values.heading: Data-Driven Maintenance, Uptime Optimization, And Connected Fleet Support
values.text:
Winslow-Gerolamy Motors Limited provides fleet maintenance solutions designed to improve productivity, reduce downtime, and lower total cost of ownership for trucking companies across Central Ontario.

Taking your productivity and profitability to the next level, we use data analytics and connected vehicle technology to deliver predictive and proactive maintenance insights that keep your fleet operating efficiently.

image.alt: A blue International truck pulling a trailer along a mountain highway

values.heading: A Data-Driven Approach To Fleet Maintenance
values.text:
Winslow-Gerolamy Motors uses advanced tools and reporting systems to help fleets move beyond reactive repairs and into proactive maintenance planning.

Our approach focuses on:

points.text: Predicting potential failures before they occur

values.textAfter: Our tools and reports are designed to take your uptime to new heights.

image.alt: A fleet manager using a fleet maintenance dashboard on two monitors

values.heading: Connected Fleet Technology
values.intro:
OnCommand Connection and International 360 are included standard for 5 years on new Class 6-8 International Truck models.

These connected vehicle platforms allow fleet operators to monitor performance, receive alerts, and manage maintenance more effectively.

values.heading: International 360
values.text:
International 360 creates seamless, transparent service communication designed to accelerate the service process and get trucks back on the road faster.
